decision_basis: Deliberate conservative product weighting directed after the frozen benchmark-v1 selection and holdout. It is not a claim of benchmark-optimal performance and does not rewrite the immutable selection decision.

evidence_summary.keyword: Keyword matching performed extremely strongly on the controlled benchmark and was the strongest selection aggregate.
evidence_summary.semantic_provider: E5 was the strongest semantic provider among the four locked candidates tested.
evidence_summary.hybrid_claim: Benchmark v1 did not demonstrate that this positive semantic weight outperformed keyword ranking. The product weighting intentionally retains majority keyword authority while enabling bounded semantic contribution.
